purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY — never design DNA. The owl template is the sole source of layout and structure.
stack: Client-side React SPA (Lovable-generated), Vite bundle, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, no SSR/prerender.
strengths: Strong, disciplined brand palette already in place: deep forest green, warm cream, gold accent, red/green logo.
Copy is genuinely good and locally specific — real price ranges, NEPA freeze-thaw language, named towns.
Complete schema.org GeneralContractor JSON-LD with NAP, geo, hours and areaServed.
Real before/after project photography rather than stock imagery.
Nine well-written service pages with benefits, four-step process, local examples and FAQs.
weaknesses: All seven service-area URLs in the sitemap (/contractor-{city}-pa) return 404 on the live site — the sitemap advertises pages that do not exist.
No server-rendered HTML. Body ships as an empty <div id="root">, so all copy, FAQ answers and service detail are invisible to crawlers that do not execute JS.
FAQ answers live only in the JS bundle — the accordion content is never in the DOM until clicked, so it cannot be indexed as FAQ content.
No Google Business Profile and zero reviews anywhere on the site — no social proof at all.
No street address published; only city/state/ZIP, which weakens local SEO.
Single-page architecture for everything except services: About, Portfolio, FAQ and Contact are hash anchors, not indexable pages.
No dedicated contact, about, pricing, gallery or legal pages (no privacy policy, terms or accessibility statement).
Contact form posts nowhere verifiable — no CRM integration detected.
No blog or any content surface for long-tail local search.
anti_patterns_observed: Hash-anchor navigation standing in for real pages
Client-side-only rendering with no prerender or SSR
_notes: Screenshot captured at 1280px wide, full page (1280x6980).
